title.zh: 将萨马省Basey市镇国立农业学校重新命名为Valeriano C. Yancha纪念学校的法案
title.en: An Act Renaming the Basey National Agricultural School in the Municipality of Basey, Province of Samar, as the Valeriano C. Yancha Memorial
title.orig: An Act Renaming the Basey National Agricultural School in the Municipality of Basey, Province of Samar, as the Valeriano C. Yancha Memorial
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường Nông nghiệp Basey Quốc gia tại Đô thị Basey, Tỉnh Samar thành Tưởng niệm Valeriano C. Yancha
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนเกษตรกรรม Basey แห่งชาติในเทศบาล Basey จังหวัด Samar เป็นอนุสรณ์ Valeriano C. Yancha
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Sekolah Pertanian Basey Nasional di Kotamadya Basey, Provinsi Samar menjadi Memorial Valeriano C. Yancha
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Sekolah Pertanian Basey Kebangsaan di Perbandaran Basey, Wilayah Samar kepada Memorial Valeriano C. Yancha

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1989/ra_6740_1989.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Basey National Agricultural School in the Municipality of Basey, Province of Samar, is hereby renamed as the Valeriano C. Yancha Memorial Agricultural School.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports is hereby directed to take cognizance and implement the provision of Section 1 hereof.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
